test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 2 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the idiom given in bold in the following sentence.

She is **green-eyed** with his success.
solution:
The correct answer is jealous.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the idiom 'green-eyed' is 'jealous'.
 
• green-eyed: jealous; envious; distrustful
 
 
• *Example: this is where I get a bit **green-eyed** and bitter.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above the correct answer is option 3.

Correct meaning:__ jealous.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Idiom**
 **Meaning**
 **Example**
 
 

 play (merry) hell with sth
 to seriously damage or confuse something
 The power cuts played hell with our computers.
 
 

 play (sth) by ear
 to play a piece of music by remembering the notes
 He did not need sheet music. He could play the piece by ear.
 
 

 play a joke/trick on sb
 to confuse someone or cause a problem for them
 Fate played a cruel trick on him when he was injured in his first game.
